prompt:
A desktop landing page for "Cak Mimin — Bumbu Rujak Manis", an East Javanese family business selling ready-made sweet rujak dressing made with real palm sugar (gula aren asli) and no preservatives (tanpa pengawet). Rendered edge to edge as a finished web page, landscape 3:2, crisp readable Indonesian text, no browser window, device or desk around it.

The visitor is deciding whether to order. This comp goes further than a hero: the page itself is a giant cut slab of gula aren seen in cross-section, its crumbly crystalline caramel texture filling the whole upper viewport as the ground, and the headline is set large in warm off-white directly on the sugar: "Manisnya dari nira, bukan dari pabrik." Subline: "Bumbu rujak manis racikan Cak Mimin. Gula aren asli, tanpa pengawet." Primary button: "Pesan via WhatsApp". A small round cobek photograph with rujak sauce and cut fruit sits overlapping the lower edge of the slab. Below the slab the next section starts on dark brown: "Satu skala, tiga rasa" — three variant jars (Original, Pedas Manis, Ekstra Kental) standing side by side, each with the same small gauge row reading Manis, Pedas, Kecut.

Frame: wordmark "Cak Mimin" top left; navigation Cerita, Varian, Cara Ngerujak, Testimoni, Kemitraan; WhatsApp order button top right.

Visual law: gula-aren browns from amber caramel to near-black molasses own the page; banana-leaf green and chili red are the only accents. Bold, characterful high-contrast serif headlines; plain sturdy sans body; tabular numerals for product specs. Real food photography.
